requiredRuntimeProof: committed reward or ownership transition proof
displayed and charged cost parity proof where costs change
persistent state save/load or lifecycle proof

requiredRuntimeSemantics: A side-scoped capture token must be created only by a committed capture or equivalent adventure-object ownership event.
The token must be consumed by a committed eligible construction transaction, not by previewing or opening the construction UI.
The token source, token owner, city owner, and active law owner must all correlate to the same Dungeon side.
forbiddenSubstitutes: building allowlist alone counted as a capture token
ordinary ownership read counted without a transfer event
captured object display text counted as a token
object icon or map visual counted as a token
construction preview counted as token consumption
global token ledger without side and source correlation

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must observe a committed mine, external dwelling, guarded object, or equivalent ownership transfer result.
A static object owner read is only context; it is not the transfer event.
Reward application must happen once after the transfer result is committed and correlated to the Dungeon law owner.
forbiddenSubstitutes: map object owned by Dungeon counted without transfer timing
combat start or win counted without ownership result
reward preview counted as committed income
mine income tick counted as capture reward
object proximity or hover text counted as ownership transfer
generic adventure reward event without captured object identity

requiredRuntimeSemantics: A mature dwelling state must be explicitly recorded for a specific Rampart city or dwelling source.
The persistent state must survive the intended lifecycle boundary before enabling an upgrade or extra construction benefit.
The mature state, target building, city owner, and active law owner must all correlate before any construction mutation.
forbiddenSubstitutes: building allowlist alone counted as mature dwelling state
any Rampart dwelling counted as mature
growth display text counted as persistent maturation
same-turn construction preview counted as mature state
visual upgrade icon counted as mature state
global mature flag without city or dwelling identity

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must represent a committed, deterministic sacrifice of units from the relevant city garrison or allowed party source.
Sacrifice value must be computed from exact unit stacks and compared against the configured percent threshold before construction is committed.
The sacrificed stack owner, city owner, construction target, and active Inferno law owner must correlate, with cancellation leaving units unchanged.
forbiddenSubstitutes: garrison existence counted as sacrifice
selected UI unit counted before transaction commit
ordinary build cost payment counted as sacrifice
Inferno faction membership counted as sacrifice
displayed cost discount counted without unit removal
temporary summon or gated unit counted as permanent sacrifice without identity proof

requiredRuntimeSemantics: Deathworks credit must be an explicit side-scoped ledger generated by committed casualty, corpse, or captured-dwelling events defined by the law packet.
The ledger must be consumed only by a committed eligible Necropolis construction transaction.
Credit source, credit owner, city owner, building allowlist, and active law owner must all correlate before an extra build or cost mutation.
forbiddenSubstitutes: corpse count alone counted as deathworks credit
undead unit identity counted as construction credit
building allowlist alone counted as credit
Necropolis faction membership counted as credit
necromancy or corpse-themed display text counted as credit
global credit ledger without side and source correlation

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must read exact committed rare-resource balances for the Tower law owner side after the reward/economy transaction point.
The transmutation policy must identify which resource types are rare resources and apply a capped conversion exactly once.
Resource reads, resource writes, reward identity, and active law owner must all correlate to the same side.
forbiddenSubstitutes: resource primitive existence counted as rare-resource balance
reward preview counted as committed resource state
gold balance counted as rare resource
generic resource delta counted without rare-resource classification
Tower faction membership counted as available transmutation
UI resource text counted without side resource heap proof
